questions.question: Before Jesus was taken up to heaven, He told His apostles to stay in Jerusalem and wait for what?

answers.text: A message from the high priest

questions.question: Jesus told His apostles they would be His witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea and Samaria. How far did He say it would go after that?

answers.text: To the ends of the earth

questions.question: As Jesus was taken up into heaven in front of His apostles, what hid Him from their sight?
After Jesus was taken up into heaven, two men in white spoke to the apostles. What did they say about Jesus?

answers.text: He will come back the same way He went
They will not see Him again on earth
They should go look for Him in Galilee
